Open a store as a dataset: every array, its dimensions, no data read

Source: R/dataset.R
zaro_dataset.Rd

Collects the metadata of every array in one group of a Zarr store (the root by default) and reports each array's dimension names and sizes in R order (the order zaro_array() returns). Consolidated metadata (.zmetadata or a consolidated zarr.json) is used when present, which is one request for the whole store. Otherwise the store is listed and each child is probed for array metadata; pass arrays to skip the listing (useful over plain HTTP, which can't list).

Usage

zaro_dataset(source, group = "", arrays = NULL, verbose = zaro_verbose(), ...)

Arguments

source

a store from zaro(), or a character source passed to zaro() along with ....

group

path of the group to open, e.g. "measurements/reflectance/r10m". Default "", the root.

arrays

optional character vector of array names (within group) to include. With consolidated metadata it filters; without, it replaces the listing.

verbose

logical. Emit diagnostic messages. Default getOption("zaro.verbose", TRUE).

...

passed to zaro() when source is character.

Value

A zaro_dataset: a list with store, group (the group's path), attributes (the group's attributes), arrays (named list of array metadata), paths (named character vector: each array's path in the store), dims (named list of R-order dimension names per array) and shape (named list of R-order sizes per array). Arrays are named within the group; zaro_array(), zaro_read() and zaro_plan() take the dataset with those names.

Details

No array data is read. Use zaro_array() on the result to get a lazy array, or zaro_read() with meta = ds$arrays[[name]].

Arrays with no dimension names (Zarr V2 without xarray's _ARRAY_DIMENSIONS) get names "<array>_dim<k>", with k the 0-based Zarr axis, so they never collide with another array's dimensions. Only arrays directly in group are included; use zaro_groups() to see a nested store's groups (e.g. EOPF and GeoZarr products, which keep their arrays several groups down).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ds <- zaro_dataset("s3://aodn-cloud-optimised/model_sea_level_anomaly_gridded_realtime.zarr",
                   anonymous = TRUE, region = "ap-southeast-2")
ds
ds$dims$GSLA                       # "LONGITUDE" "LATITUDE" "TIME"
gsla <- zaro_array(ds, "GSLA", cf = TRUE)

## a nested store: list the groups, open one
eopf_url <- paste0(
  "https://s3.explorer.eopf.copernicus.eu/esa-zarr-sentinel-explorer-fra/",
  "tests-output/sentinel-2-l2a/",
  "S2C_MSIL2A_20260120T084301_N0511_R064_T36UXA_20260120T122910.zarr")
eopf <- zaro(eopf_url)
zaro_groups(eopf)
r10m <- zaro_dataset(eopf, group = "measurements/reflectance/r10m")
b04 <- zaro_array(r10m, "b04")
} # }
